CHAPTER VI.
Pig and Pepper


A Fish-Footman delivered an invitation from the Queen to the
Duchess, handed off to a Frog-Footman. Inside the smoky kitchen, the
Duchess nursed a howling, sneezing baby while the cook stirred a
peppery soup and a Cheshire Cat grinned on the hearth. The Duchess
gave the baby to Alice, who carried it outside, only to discover it
was slowly turning into a pig; she set it down and it trotted away
into the wood.

Alice then met the Cheshire Cat again, who directed her toward the
March Hare's house, remarking that everyone in the area was mad,
including itself and Alice.
